# Bone and display keys of chain8.pmx: register, copy, the three pastes,
# delete, frame lines, undo and redo, and the VMD, VPD, PMD, and PMM saves.
load model chain8.pmx
frame 10
select bone センター
bone position 1 2 3
bone rotation 10 20 30
register bone
frame 20
select bone 上半身
bone rotation 0 45 0
register bone
frame 15
register display
save pmm registered.pmm
select all bone
save vmd registered.vmd

# Copy every bone key, paste at 40 and mirrored at 60.
select all bone
copy
frame 40
paste
frame 60
paste reverse
save pmm pasted.pmm

# Paste the clipboard onto another bone (首) at frame 80.
select bone 首
frame 80
paste different
save pmm pasted-different.pmm

# Frame lines: insert at 30 shifts the keys after it, delete at 5 pulls them back.
frame 30
line insert bone
save pmm line-inserted.pmm
frame 5
line delete bone
save pmm line-deleted.pmm

# Undo the line deletion and redo it.
undo
save pmm undone.pmm
redo
save pmm redone.pmm

# Delete the selected keys at the current frame.
select all bone
frame 41
delete
select all bone
save vmd deleted.vmd

# The pose of the selected bone, the whole scene, and last the PMD writer
# (menu 263 writes the PMD layout, so it gets the PMD model; it also makes the
# saved path, which is in <out-dir>, the model's path for later PMM saves).
frame 10
select bone センター
save vpd center.vpd
load model chain8.pmd
save pmm bones.pmm
save pmd chain8-saved.pmd
